IOCL Executive Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL) has released the admit card for the post of Executive. This recruitment was released for 394 posts. Applications for the IOCL Executive Recruitment 2026 were accepted from August 14, 2026, to September 03, 2026. The CBT examination is going to be conducted on 24 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their IOCL Executive Admit Card 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 August 2026
  • Last Date : 03 September 2026
  • Fees Payment Last Date : 03 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 24 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 17 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
